name: en2tw-alignment-sft
description: A supervised fine-tuning / alignment dataset mapping English inputs to Taiwanese (or Traditional Chinese/Taiwanese) outputs intended to train models for cross-lingual alignment and translation-style instruction following. It provides parallel or aligned pairs useful for supervised fine-tuning of sequence-to-sequence models. Evaluation focuses on fidelity of translation/alignment and alignment to intended instructions.
evaluation_method: BLEU / chrF and human evaluation for alignment quality
reputation: A small, task-specific HF dataset used for supervised fine-tuning in multilingual/alignment experiments; relatively niche.
